title: The Four Seasons
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: The Four Seasons Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe the changes in each season in Ontario and how plants, animals and people adapt to seasonal changes. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand E: Earth and Space Systems – Daily and Seasonal Changes)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on winter, spring, summer and fall in Ontario and how plants, animals and people change, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: In each season the weather, plants and animals change, and so do the clothes we wear.
body_html:
How to think about it

Ontario has four seasons: winter, spring, summer and fall.

  • Winter is cold and snowy; summer is hot.
  • Leaves change colour and fall in the fall.
  • Some animals sleep or fly south for winter.
Example

Which season comes after fall?

fall, then …

Answer: winter

Example

What do bears do in winter?

they rest

Answer: sleep in a den

Common mistakes

  • Thinking it is hot all year everywhere.
  • Thinking all trees lose their leaves (pines stay green).
